fact: Togo-Presse reports that in 2024 the CFE and the RCCM were connected with other administrative platforms and that a citizen can create a company account online through the Services publics portal.
Togo-Presse reports that a database of companies' beneficial owners has been created, to identify who really holds a company.

The Full-News article says firms can check name availability, file statutes, pay fees and receive registration documents online through the CFE site cfetogo.tg, in under four hours, with online payment since 2019.

Togo Officiel says the DGDN, the business formalities centre (CFE) and the commercial register (RCCM) are now connected so users can do several procedures through one channel, notably company creation.
Togo Officiel says a database of companies' beneficial owners has been created to identify who really owns a company.
